status: Draft defaults, v0.2 calibration: hazards cap the band and any variance caps the zoning sub-score. Every number here is editable and awaits owner / SME review.

sourceCoverage._note: Share of target parcels each source covers (0-1). Fill from the data audit; a source below coverageThreshold marks its factor as partial coverage. Sources not listed are not flagged.

zba._note: Grant odds: this district's decided cases of the relief type when there are at least minCases; otherwise citywide decided cases of the same relief type (labeled with the case count and years); defaultGrantRate only when neither is available, and then it is labeled a default.

f1.contextualFrontSetbackNote: Assumed front setback when the contextual rule applies. Neighbors' setbacks are not measured yet.
f1.varianceProbeNote: Setbacks tried to see whether a dimensional variance could make a building fit at all.
f1.permissionNote: P by right, A administrator exception, S special exception, C conditional use, N not allowed (0 points; the use would need a rezoning or a use variance, so the option shows as "not allowed"; was 15 before 2026-09-27). nonconformingContinuation applies to rehab of an existing residential building whose use the district no longer permits (continued as a legal nonconforming use); default pending review of the Chapter 921 text.

f3._note: slopeMovementOnLot uses the 1982 county slope-movement inventory (mapped areas, not recent slides), counted only where a mapped area touches the lot.

permitTimeQueries._note: Which permit_time_estimate(permit_type, work_type) row feeds each strategy's building-permit time. Pass the results as extras.permitTimes.

months._note: Heuristic months, labeled as estimates. Hearing-based approvals use the ZBA record: hearing to decision median ~35 days (1.2 mo) and decision to permit median ~68 days (2.3 mo, added once). Other values are placeholders. 'base' stands in for the building permit only when permit-time records are not supplied.

f7._note: Percentile rank (0-100) of nearby valid sales + completed permits is the sub-score.

caps._note: v0.2 calibration. hazardBand: a lot this landslide-prone or this steep cannot score above maxBand (the score is clamped to that band's ceiling and labeled). varianceF1Max: the zoning sub-score (F1) is scaled to at most this when the chosen scheme needs any dimensional variance, so a variance path never reads as a sure thing.

redFlags._note: Red flags are only: FEMA floodway, no legal access, active contamination site on the parcel.

groutingCostUsd.label: Editable default for mine grouting, not a quote. Actual cost depends on mine depth and lot size.

reviewCallouts.geotechReportCostNote: No default set: get quotes from a geotechnical engineer.
